text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Friday instructed Prime Minister Karoui to speed up reforms regarding agriculture, investment and export.
- Tunisian-French joint chamber of commerce on Friday presented its programme for 1997 including meetings on trade and partnership.
- Telecommunications sector was boosted in 1996 with the adding of 250,000 new electronic telephone lines.
- Phosphate production rose by 13.7 percent in 1996.
